autoModeTeam.title: Auto mode for the team
autoModeTeam.subtitle: Execution has started. Turning on auto mode for the chosen agents lets their next commands run without asking for approval — including outside the project folder. It is an offer: nothing changes without the click below, and each agent keeps its own manual/auto toggle.

released.summary: What the autopilot releases and what it does not
released.title: Auto mode is the autopilot — it releases, without asking:
released.commands: any command inside the project's container, even with a path outside the project folder
released.compound: compound commands with a segment that has no rule in permissions.json
released.commitBranch: git commit and creating a LOCAL branch
released.pushPr: git push and opening a PR
released.alwaysAllow: clicking "Approve and create rule" on this agent does not turn the autopilot off

notReleased.title: Auto mode does NOT release — these still ask for your approval:
notReleased.merge: merge into a protected branch (dev, qa, main)
notReleased.parallelize: parallelizing or raising the parallelism ceiling
notReleased.deny: what is in deny (or ask) in permissions.json stays as written
notReleased.turnOff: To turn it off, use the manual/auto toggle on each agent's card.

autoModeTeam.noRole: Turning on auto mode requires the maintainer role (read from the workspace; the project role is not checked here).
